generation.description: The generation it holds: the one before the repair.

path.description: The `.ewz` file, `<project folder>.before-repair-g<generation>.ewz` beside the project folder.

reused.description: Whether it was there already, holding this generation's pack byte for byte, and was reused.

file.description: The file, relative to the project directory.

line.description: The 1-based line in the generation before the repair.

text.description: Its text as shown: invalid UTF-8 as U+FFFD, cut after 80 characters with "…" (the backup holds the line whole).

file.description: The file, relative to the project directory.

removed.description: Whether nothing is left in it and it is removed (its records belong in other files).

file.description: The file, relative to the project directory.

line.description: The 1-based line; `null` for a whole file.

description:
`ew fmt --repair --json` ([`FMT_REPAIR`]; WP-S1.17, decision log ID-1185): the broken lines discarded (EW-CORE-005 at
line level), the backup of the generation before, the files the save rewrote, and the lines kept verbatim.

backup.description: The backup `.ewz` of the generation before the repair; `null` when there was nothing to repair.

discarded.description: The lines discarded, in file and line order; empty when there was nothing to repair.

files.description: The files the save rewrote or removed, in path order.

kept.description:
The lines (or files) the open kept verbatim that stay: the other quarantined lines, malformed values, unknown
kinds, members or files.
